name: lifecycle teardown tickets must run acceptance under multi-worktree conditions

scenarios.name: a lifecycle teardown ticket refuses land on single-worktree-only acceptance

steps.text: a lifecycle teardown ticket whose acceptance has not been executed under multi-worktree conditions
the pilot attempts to land the ticket
the refusal names single-worktree-only acceptance as insufficient

scenarios.name: lifecycle teardown acceptance executes with a sibling worktree handoffd active

steps.text: at least two worktrees for this repo are active
a sibling worktree has handoffd.bb running for its own root
the pilot runs the ticket's acceptance contract before land
the acceptance pipeline executes under that multi-worktree fixture
the run records multi-worktree environment metadata

scenarios.name: a green multi-worktree acceptance run lands with environment on the receipt

steps.text: a lifecycle teardown ticket whose acceptance passes under multi-worktree conditions
the ticket yaml is moved to backlog/done/
the acceptance receipt records the multi-worktree fixture was used

scenarios.name: a failed multi-worktree acceptance run refuses land without side effects

steps.text: a lifecycle teardown ticket whose acceptance fails under multi-worktree conditions
the pilot attempts to land the ticket
the ticket yaml still sits in backlog/active/

background.text: the pilot acceptance gate is the only landing path
a lifecycle or teardown-script ticket declares an acceptance feature
